arxiv-1705-00518.title: Self-Dual Systems, their Symmetries and Reductions to the Bogoyavlensky Lattice This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Symmetries and Integrability of Difference Equations. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/SIDE12.html
arxiv-1705-00518.creator: Allan P. FORDY † and Pavlos XENITIDIS ‡
arxiv-1705-00518.description: Abstract We recently introduced a class of ℤ N {\mathbb{Z}}_{N} graded discrete Lax pairs and studied the associated discrete integrable systems (lattice equations). In particular, we introduced a subclass, which we called “self-dual”. In this paper we discuss the continuous symmetries of these systems, their reductions and the relation of the latter to the Bogoyavlensky equation.

arxiv-2105-09697.title: Modeling the effects of social distancing on the large-scale spreading of diseases
arxiv-2105-09697.creator: Paulo Cesar Ventura 1, Alberto Aleta 2, Francisco A. Rodrigues 3, Yamir Moreno 2,4
arxiv-2105-09697.description: Abstract To contain the propagation of emerging diseases that are transmissible from human to human, non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) aimed at reducing the interactions between humans are usually implemented. One example of the latter kind of measures is social distancing, which can be either policy-driven or can arise endogenously in the population as a consequence of the fear of infection.

arxiv-2208-03998.title: I Learn to Diffuse, or Data Alchemy 101: a Mnemonic Manifesto
arxiv-2208-03998.creator: Victor Schetinger TU Wien, Velitchko Filipov TU Wien, Ignacio Pérez-Messina TU Wien, Ethan Smith University of Florida, Rodrigo Oliveira de Oliveira Unochapecó
arxiv-2208-03998.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Victor Schetinger TU Wien, Velitchko Filipov TU Wien, Ignacio Pérez-Messina TU Wien, Ethan Smith University of Florida, Rodrigo Oliveira de Oliveira Unochapecó. In this manifesto, we put forward the idea of data alchemy as a narrative device to discuss storytelling and transdisciplinarity in visualization. If data is the prima materia of modern science, how does one perform the Great Work?

arxiv-2401-02958.title: Phantom Fluid Cosmology or Ghosts for Gordon
arxiv-2401-02958.creator: James M. Cline
arxiv-2401-02958.description: Abstract The quanta of phantom dark energy models are negative energy particles, whose maximum magnitude of energy | E | |E| must be less than a cutoff Λ ≲ 20 \Lambda\lesssim 20 MeV. They are produced by spontaneous decay of the vacuum into phantoms plus normal particles.

arxiv-2407-08921.title: Cosmological bounds on a possible electron-to-proton mass ratio variation and constraints in the lepton specific 2HDM
arxiv-2407-08921.creator: R. G. Albuquerque 1, R. F. L. Holanda 2,3, I. E. T. R. Mendonça 2,5, P. S. Rodrigues da Silva 1
arxiv-2407-08921.description: Abstract In this work, we test a possible redshift variation of the electron-to-proton mass ratio, μ = m e / m p \mu=m_{e}/m_{p} , directly from galaxy cluster gas mass fraction measurements and type Ia supernovae observations. Our result reveals no variation of μ \mu within 1 σ \sigma .

arxiv-2408-05473.title: Maximal Ideals in Functions Rings with a Countable Pointfree Image
arxiv-2408-05473.creator: Mostafa Abedi Esfarayen University of Technology, Esfarayen, North Khorasan, Iran Email Address: ms - abedi@yahoo.com, abedi@esfarayen.ac.ir
arxiv-2408-05473.description: Abstract . Consider the subring ℛ c ​ L \mathcal{R}_{c}L of continuous real-valued functions defined on a frame L L , comprising functions with a countable pointfree image. We present some useful properties of ℛ c ​ L \mathcal{R}_{c}L .

arxiv-2409-07467.title: Flexible Control in Symbolic Music Generation via Musical Metadata
arxiv-2409-07467.creator: Sangjun Han, Jiwon Ham, Chaeeun Lee, Heejin Kim, Soojong Do, Sihyuk Yi, Seoyoon Kim, Yountae Jung, Woohyung Lim
arxiv-2409-07467.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce the demonstration of symbolic music generation, focusing on providing short musical motifs that serve as the central theme of the narrative. For the generation, we adopt an autoregressive model which takes musical metadata as inputs and generates 4 bars of multitrack MIDI sequences.

arxiv-2412-10409.title: Generating Minimum Free Energy Paths With Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
arxiv-2412-10409.creator: Vladimir Grigorev Department of Physics and Astronomy, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, USA
arxiv-2412-10409.description: Abstract A method combining denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) with the string method is presented to generate minimum free energy paths between metastable states in molecular systems. It has been demonstrated in recent work that DDPMs at low noise levels can approximate the gradient of the potential of mean force, allowing efficient sampling of high-dimensional configurational spaces.

arxiv-2412-21030.title: Improving Location-based Thermal Emission Side-Channel Analysis Using Iterative Transfer Learning
arxiv-2412-21030.creator: Tun-Chieh Lou, Chung-Che Wang, Jyh-Shing Roger Jang, Henian Li, Lang Lin, Norman Chang
arxiv-2412-21030.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tun-Chieh Lou, Chung-Che Wang, Jyh-Shing Roger Jang, Henian Li, Lang Lin, Norman Chang. This paper proposes the use of iterative transfer learning applied to deep learning models for side-channel attacks. Currently, most of the side-channel attack methods train a model for each individual byte, without considering the correlation between bytes.

arxiv-2501-10798.title: Critical radii and suprema of random waves over Riemannian manifolds
arxiv-2501-10798.creator: Renjie Feng, Dong Yao, Robert J. Adler
arxiv-2501-10798.description: Abstract . We study random waves on smooth, compact, Riemannian manifolds under the spherical ensemble. Our first main result shows that there is a positive universal limit for the critical radius of a specific deterministic embedding, defined via the eigenfunctions of the Laplace-Beltrami operator, of such manifolds into higher dimensional Euclidean spaces.

arxiv-2509-07826.title: Spin susceptibility in a pseudogap state with fluctuating spiral magnetic order
arxiv-2509-07826.creator: Paulo Forni, Pietro M. Bonetti, Henrik Müller-Groeling, Demetrio Vilardi, Walter Metzner
arxiv-2509-07826.description: Abstract We compute the electron spin susceptibility in the pseudogap regime of the two-dimensional Hubbard model in the framework of a SU(2) gauge theory of fluctuating magnetic order. The electrons are fractionalized in fermionic chargons with a pseudospin degree of freedom and bosonic spinons.

pmc-11455370.title: 6912 Nail Fold Capillary Findings In Patients With Somatic EPAS1 Pathogenic Variants
pmc-11455370.creator: H Alkaissi, B Turturice, J S Rosenblum, A S Alzahrani, S Talvacchio, A Derkyi, M Nazari, H Wang, I Pinal Fernandez, Z Zhuang, K Pacak
pmc-11455370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Pinal Fernandez: None. Pacak: None.We recently discovered a new syndrome characterized by a triad of pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma, polycythemia, and somatostatinoma (so called Pacak-Zhuang syndrome) caused by somatic gain-of-function pathogenic variants in the EPAS1 gene, encoding hypoxia-inducible factor 2α (HIF-2α). Recently, we have described additional features of this syndrome, including systemic developmental vascular malformations in patients and the mouse model [1].

pmc-11688613.description: s well as the duration of exposure, benefits animals. Reducing the time needed for preclinical development also benefits patients. Although focusing mainly on studies in rats, the Addendum to the ICH S1B (R1) (International Council for Harmonisation, 2022) Guideline on testing for carcinogenicity of pharmaceuticals promises to decrease the number of long-term studies in both rats and mice.

pmc-11716684.title: Aβ42/40 and p‐tau 181 as disease biomarkers in Atypical Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11716684.creator: Neha Atulkumar Singh, Jonathan Graff‐Radford, Danni Li, Michelle M Mielke, Mary M Machulda, Christopher G Schwarz, Matthew L Senjem, Clifford R Jack, Val J Lowe, Keith A Josephs, Jennifer L Whitwell
pmc-11716684.description: BackgroundBlood plasma metrics provide excellent biomarkers of the presence of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology in population cohorts. However, it is less clear whether plasma metrics correlate with PET measures of AD pathology in cohorts of patients with advanced AD disease, particularly in those with atypical clinical presentations of AD.

pmc-12450482.title: Overwhelming Gradient of Aortic Stenosis in the Context of Dysthyroidism: A Case Report
pmc-12450482.creator: Mouad Lamtai, Loubna Elkhadir, Hajar Moukane, Nora Bennani, Rokia Fellat, Nadia Fellat
pmc-12450482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Thyroid hormones significantly influence the heart's metabolism, playing a key role in regulating cardiac function and cardiovascular hemodynamics. In cases of thyrotoxicosis, the excessive production of thyroid hormones induces remarkable hemodynamic alterations in the cardiovascular system. In this report, we discuss the case of a 70-year-old patient admitted for dyspnea with a severe high gradient of aortic stenosis due to an overactive thyroid. This case report aims to illustrate the impact of systemic conditions on cardiac hemodynamics.

pmc-12786596.title: Tailoring Microstructure and Properties of CoCrNiAlTiNb High-Entropy Alloy Coatings via Laser Power Control During Laser Cladding
pmc-12786596.creator: Zhe Zhang, Yue Yu, Xiaoming Chen, Li Fu, Xin Wei, Wenyuan Zhang, Zhao Dong, Mingming Wang, Tuo Wang, Xidong Hui
pmc-12786596.description: To enhance the operational damage resistance of hydraulic machinery, this study employed laser cladding technology to fabricate a Co37.4Cr30Ni20Al5Ti5Nb2.6 high-entropy alloy coating on 04Cr13Ni5Mo substrate. The influence of laser power on the microstructure and properties of the coating was systematically investigated.

pmc-12894316.title: YOLO-LitchiVar: a lightweight and high-precision detection model for fine-grained litchi variety identification
pmc-12894316.creator: Bing Xu, Xianjun Wu, Xueping Su, Wende Ke
pmc-12894316.description: Pengju Ren, Shanghai Maritime University, ChinaLitchi is a popular subtropical fruit with approximately 100 known varieties worldwide. Traditional post-harvest litchi variety classification primarily relies on manual identification, which suffers from low efficiency, strong subjectivity, and a lack of standardized systems.

pmc-12905810.title: Validation of Platelet-index based Score (PIBS) for Early Prediction of the Pathological Stage in Colorectal Cancer
pmc-12905810.creator: Adi Madethen, Ronald Erasio Lusikooy, Julianus Aboyaman Uwuratuw, Sachraswaty Rahman Laidding, Warsinggih Warsinggih, Erwin Syarifuddin, Ibrahim Labeda, Murny Abdul Rauf, Samuel Sampetoding, Muhammad Ihwan Kusuma, Arham Arsyad, Citra Ariyanti, Amirullah Abdi
pmc-12905810.description: Introduction: Accurate staging is essential in colorectal cancer (CRC) management. Platelet indices have emerged as promising biomarkers of tumor burden and progression. This study aimed to validate the Platelet Index-Based Score (PIBS-CRC), a machine learning-based model using platelet parameters, for predicting the pathological TNM stage of CRC.

pmc-13368834.title: Engineered membrane-coated nanoparticles enhance ferroptosis and microtubule inhibition in prostate cancer
pmc-13368834.creator: Kunmu Yang, Yingwei Wang, Chuan Guo, Xiaoxiong Zhang, Jian Wu
pmc-13368834.description: Prostate cancer (PCa), characterized by its high incidence and progression to treatment-resistant stages, remains a major clinical challenge. Herein, we developed a membrane-coated Cabazitaxel (Cab)@TA–Fe³⁺ nanoplatform for enhanced PCa therapy. The nanoparticles demonstrated notable anticancer effects, with cytotoxicity increasing over time and with dose, along with significant inhibition of cell migration and induction of G2/M phase arrest in LNCaP cells.

pmc-13385509.title: Physical fitness indicators and physical activity behind self-determined motivation in Emirati female college students
pmc-13385509.creator: Arto Gråstén, Balazs Gabor, Gehan Handouk, Jamal Alnuaimi
pmc-13385509.description: BackgroundPhysical inactivity is a public health concern, especially among young Middle Eastern women. Individuals with higher levels of physical fitness are more likely to engage in regular moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA), as lower physical effort may reduce discomfort during activities and enhance motivation to remain active.

pmc-13606312.title: Can Micro- and Nanoplastics Modify Food-Allergy-Relevant Pathways?—A Comprehensive Narrative Review
pmc-13606312.creator: Natalia Rutkowska, Dawid Wisniewski, Patrycja Rogala, Michal Ostrowski, Sylwia Smolinska-Wilczynska
pmc-13606312.description: Micro- and nanoplastics (MNPs) are widely detected in food, drinking water, food-contact materials, and human biological samples. This narrative review evaluates whether experimental evidence supports a role for MNPs as modifiers of food-allergen digestion, intestinal-barrier function, microbiota composition, and immune tolerance.
